spill_dir.description:
Provider-local directory where complete output is retained when the
inline result exceeds `output_limit`.

tool_call_id.description:
Optional caller-owned correlation id. Bash supplies its tool-call id so
user-facing command telemetry can update the corresponding Console row
without exposing provider/session handles.

CompanionLifecycleState.description: Public lifecycle projection for the Workspace Companion endpoint.

CompanionMessageDisposition.description: Public outcome of a Companion message submission.

CompanionTranscriptItem.description: One allowlisted, user-visible Companion transcript item.

CompanionTranscriptRole.description: User-visible role accepted in the public Companion transcript.

CompanionTransportSummary.description: Public, bounded transport metadata for Companion status.

ConfigCommitRequest.description: Compare-and-swap request for applying a complete set of source-tree changes.

ConfigContentType.description: Source content kinds accepted by the Workspace configuration tree.

ConfigEntry.description: One source entry in the Workspace configuration tree.

ConfigTreeChange.description: Base-relative change applied by a Workspace configuration commit.

CreateWorkspaceRepositoryRequest.description:
Browser/user intent for registering one Repository in a Workspace.

The Server parses and canonicalizes `source`; callers cannot assert a
transport classification or supply credential material through this DTO.

control_operation_id.description: Backend idempotency key used only for authenticated Worker-owned spawn/control.

EvidenceKind.description:
Extensible evidence kind tag used by staging source anchors.

Known values include `message`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `file_ref`,
`ticket_ref`, and `objective_ref`, but callers may use newer bounded tags
without changing the schema.

EvidenceOrigin.description:
Bounded origin snapshot attached to extraction evidence. This is audit
metadata only and cannot authorize Workspace operations.

ExtractedCandidate.description: Model-submitted candidate before host-side staging metadata is attached.

evidence_ids.description:
Evidence ids selected by the extract worker. The transitional
`write_extracted` path may leave this empty until `session-explore`
provides host-issued evidence ids.

kind.description:
Kind of candidate. This is intentionally a narrow taxonomy, not an
activity-log category.

why_useful.description: Why this may be useful for future work or consolidation.

ExtractedPayload.description: Transitional extract output: zero or more flat candidates.

FlowSourceRecord.description: Current source record for one Workspace-authored Flow.

FsPath.description:
Scope-checked filesystem path. Relative paths resolve below the bound
Workdir root; absolute paths require an explicit matching scope rule.

output.description:
Provider-rendered bounded grep report. Keeping rendering here avoids
transferring candidate files across a remote provider boundary.

InitialRepositoryIntent.description: Initial Repository registration intent for Workspace creation.

InvalidProjectRecord.description: One malformed project record reported by a bounded list projection.

MemoryBackendRequest.description: Public wrapper retaining the established tagged Memory backend wire shape.

MemoryBackendResponse.description: Public wrapper retaining the established tagged Memory backend response shape.

MemoryCandidateKind.description: Candidate kinds exposed by the Memory staging resource.

MemoryEvidenceOrigin.description:
Bounded origin metadata copied from one typed Memory evidence anchor.

This is provenance only. It carries no message body, prompt, reasoning,
secret, tool output, or authorization authority.

MemoryEvidenceOriginKind.description: Typed, bounded provenance classification for public Memory evidence anchors.

MemoryJsonSafeU64.description:
Schema-only representation for JSON integers that must remain exactly
representable by JavaScript consumers.

MemorySourceEvidenceRef.description: Bounded source anchor included in one Memory staging record.

MemorySourceRef.description: Record-level source range for one Memory staging candidate.

MemoryStagingEntry.description: Public list entry for one valid Memory staging record.

MemoryStagingEvidence.description: Bounded evidence snippet included in one Memory staging record.

MemoryStagingListResponse.description: Public response returned by the Workspace Memory staging list resource.

MemoryStagingQuery.description: Query parameters for the bounded Memory staging list.

MemoryStagingRecord.description: Public projection of one valid Memory staging record.

PasteArtifactMediaType.description:
One typed piece of a user submission.

`Method::Submit` and `Event::UserMessage` carry `Vec<Segment>`. Dumb
clients (CLI piping, scripts) only need to produce a single
`Segment::Text`; richer clients (TUI / GUI) construct typed atoms
(paste chips, file refs) and
send them through directly so the Worker side never has to re-parse a
flattened string.

Forward compat: payloads with unknown `kind` deserialize to
`Segment::Unknown`. Worker treats this the same as known-but-unresolved
variants — emits an alert and inserts a `[unknown input segment]`
placeholder into the LLM context so neither user nor LLM is blind to
the dropped intent.

PasteArtifactRef.description:
Session-owned reference to a large pasted-input artifact.

The reference contains only bounded integrity and provenance metadata. The
artifact body remains in session storage and is available to the model only
through the scoped paste-artifact tools installed by Worker.

availability.description:
Availability observed when this immutable reference was committed.
Reads revalidate storage and integrity rather than trusting this field.

ProfileSettingsResponse.description: Read-only Profile catalog projected from one active Workspace config revision.

RepositoryAccessProjection.description: Secret-free active Repository access projection consumed by later Runtime work.

RepositoryApiError.description: Error body shared by the existing repository routes and their generated adapters.

RepositorySource.description: Stable Repository source identity stored by Workspace authority.

uri.description:
Canonical source representation. This is an absolute local path for
`local_path`, and a normalized URI/remote specification otherwise.

RepositorySourceKind.description:
Provider-neutral classification of an authoritative Repository source.

Local paths remain distinct from network Git transports so callers cannot
accidentally treat an unmaterialized remote as a server-local filesystem path.

oneOf.description:
A legacy value that could not be classified during migration. It remains
inspectable but every provider operation must fail closed. Historical
`http` wire values decode into this non-executable classification.

RepositorySshCredential.description:
Public metadata for one Workspace-scoped Repository SSH credential.

Secret references and secret material are deliberately not part of this DTO.

RepositorySshHostTrust.description: Public metadata for an explicitly pinned SSH host key.

RepositorySshHostTrustMutationResponse.description: Public metadata for an explicitly pinned SSH host key.

RuntimeWorkerShowResponse.description:
Workspace-authoritative Worker projection.

`resource_key` is required here even though Runtime-internal Worker summaries
do not carry one. The Workspace Server must resolve it from Workspace
authority before constructing this response.

state.description:
Runtime catalog lifecycle compatibility state. Live foreground state, when
available, is carried separately in `worker_state`.

RuntimeWorkingDirectoryCleanupTarget.description:
Runtime-internal Workdir cleanup authority. This transport intentionally
retains the Backend-generated Repository id and is never a Workspace public
projection.

RuntimeWorkingDirectorySummary.description:
Runtime-internal Workdir inventory transport. Workspace REST and model-facing
surfaces must project this through [`WorkingDirectorySummary`] so the UUID is
replaced with `repository_key`.

display_name.description: Optional human-facing label, never a routing key.

oneOf.description: Free-form text. The fallback every client can produce.

Bracketed-paste capture from a TUI-style client. `id`, `chars`
and `lines` carry the metadata needed to re-render a
`[Clipboard #N | X chars, Y lines]` chip in `Event::UserMessage`
re-broadcast.

Client-local file uploaded into the owning Worker session before submit.
The Session Log stores only this immutable reference, never file bytes or
the client's local path.

`@<path>` file-system reference. Worker resolves readable files to
`[File: <path>]` attachments and readable normal directories to shallow
`[Dir: <path>]` listings; the flattened user text keeps the literal
`@<path>` placeholder either way.

Source-qualified request for the host to start a Flow before committing
this user input. Runtime resolves it through Workspace authority and
replaces it with the entered state's instructions before Worker-side
input resolution.

Unknown variant from a newer client. Worker treats this as an
unresolved input — surfaces an alert and inserts a placeholder.
Round-trip is lossy: re-serializing yields `{"kind":"unknown"}`.

SourceEvidenceRef.description:
Host-resolved source/evidence metadata for an individual staging claim.

This deliberately stores only bounded anchor metadata: stable ids, entry
ranges, and short labels/summaries. It must not carry raw message bodies or
full tool result content.

entry_range.description: `[start_entry, end_entry]` inclusive range of session-store entry indices.

evidence_id.description: Host-assigned evidence id within the referenced evidence set.

label.description: Short host-provided display label, not raw evidence content.

origin.description: Trusted typed origin snapshot for this logical evidence entry.

segment_id.description: Session segment id containing the anchored log entries.

session_id.description: Stable session id when the anchor crosses or disambiguates segments.

summary.description: Short host-provided summary, not raw evidence content.

SourceRef.description:
Reference to a session-store entry range. Stored in `sources` /
`last_sources` arrays for traceability back to raw session logs.

range.description: `[start_entry, end_entry]` inclusive range of session-store entry indices.

StagingEvidence.description: Bounded evidence snippet copied into a flat staging record.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the ticket's `artifacts/` directory.

body.description:
Whole-body replacement for legacy authoring surfaces. Prefer `body_replacement`
for small edits that should be validated against the current body.

UpdateWorkspaceMemorySettingsRequest.description: Compare-and-swap update for Workspace-owned Memory settings.

UpdateWorkspaceMetadataRequest.description: Compare-and-swap update for Workspace identity display metadata.

UploadedFileAvailability.description: Availability recorded for an uploaded client-local file.

UploadedFileRef.description:
Session-owned immutable reference to a client-local uploaded file.

Upload transports return an unbound reference. Worker fills
`source_entry_id` immediately before the containing user input is committed;
committed Session Log and public snapshot records therefore always retain
the durable source-entry identity without storing the file body.

WorkdirOperationApiError.description:
Error body for current-Worker Workdir operations.

Domain/service failures preserve the existing Repository-style API envelope,
while provider failures preserve the established typed Workdir transport
envelope and HTTP status classification.

WorkdirScopeAuthorizationRequest.description: Provider-side check for one operation under an attenuated tool scope.

WorkdirScopeOverlapRequest.description: Provider-side overlap comparison that keeps resolved host paths private.

WorkdirTransportErrorCode.description: Stable, host-path-free error code crossing the Runtime boundary.

WorkerLaunchWorkerSummary.description:
Runtime-owned Worker summary embedded in Worker launch responses.

This preserves the existing launch wire shape. Workspace-owned Worker list
and detail responses use [`WorkerSummary`] instead.

WorkerRestoreState.description:
Cross-layer outcome of an explicit Worker restore operation.

`Rejected` is reserved for read-only preflight failures. Once live restore
work starts, failure is either a confirmed `RolledBack` operation or a
`ReconciliationRequired` result whose commit state must be reread/retried.

last_command_id.description: Highest lifecycle command id observed by this controller instance.

WorkerSummary.description:
Workspace-authoritative Worker projection.

`resource_key` is required here even though Runtime-internal Worker summaries
do not carry one. The Workspace Server must resolve it from Workspace
authority before constructing this response.

state.description:
Runtime catalog lifecycle compatibility state. Live foreground state, when
available, is carried separately in `worker_state`.

WorkerWorkdirAttachmentSummary.description:
One Workspace Worker Workdir attachment. `alias` is the stable Worker-local
routing key; the nested Workdir id and display name are inventory metadata.

WorkingDirectoryCreateRequest.description:
Browser/Rust-client Workdir materialization request.

`runtime_id = None` requests Workspace default Runtime resolution and
`operation_id = Some(_)` fences exact replay. All four fields deliberately
preserve the Server's existing optionality.

display_name.description: Optional human-facing label, independent of every Worker attachment alias.

WorkingDirectoryMaterializerKind.description:
Public Workdir materializer classification.

The value identifies stable materialization provenance without exposing a
provider path, Runtime handle, or session identity.

WorkingDirectoryOccupancy.description: Durable Workspace occupancy projection for one Workdir.

WorkingDirectorySource.description: Public Workdir source identity. Provider routing details and host paths are intentionally absent.

display_name.description: Optional human-facing label, never a routing key.

WorkspaceAuthConfig.description: Browser authentication configuration exposed by the scoped Workspace summary.

WorkspaceCatalogListResponse.description:
Public response returned by `GET /api/workspaces`.

The transparent newtype keeps the established top-level JSON array while making the
complete list response a named cross-crate and generated-TypeScript authority.

WorkspaceConfigTreeResponse.description: Workspace configuration tree plus the exact evaluation contract that produced it.

WorkspaceCreateRequest.description: Request for atomically creating a Workspace and its initial Repository.

WorkspaceCreateResponse.description: Response returned after atomically creating a Workspace and its first Repository.

WorkspaceDeletionBlocker.description: One bounded, user-actionable blocker returned by preflight or execution.

WorkspaceDeletionBlockerKind.description: Stable category explaining why Workspace deletion cannot currently advance.

WorkspaceDeletionOperationResponse.description: Durable deletion operation projection used by request responses and polling.

WorkspaceDeletionPreflightResponse.description: Owner-only impact preview for deleting one Workspace.

expected_revision.description: Opaque persisted Workspace metadata revision used as a CAS fence.

WorkspaceDeletionRequest.description: Idempotent request to start or resume Workspace deletion.

WorkspaceDeletionResourceCounts.description: Workspace-owned resources summarized before destructive confirmation.

WorkspaceDeletionState.description: Lifecycle state for one durable Workspace deletion operation.

WorkspaceMemorySettings.description: Workspace-owned Memory settings returned by the shared Server API.

WorkspaceMetadataSettingsResponse.description: Workspace display metadata exposed from the Server DB settings authority.

WorkspacePermissionSummary.description: Backend-authoritative permissions for the current Workspace actor.

WorkspacePromptProjection.description: Effective Prompt catalog projected from one immutable Workspace config revision.

WorkspacePublicIdentityBundle.description: Copyable public trust bundle consumed by future Runtime enrollment work.

WorkspaceRepositoryRecord.description: Public Repository record embedded in Workspace creation responses.

WorkspaceResponse.description: Scoped Workspace metadata and current-actor permission projection.

WorkspaceSigningIdentityPublic.description:
Public metadata for a Workspace signing identity. Private material and its
storage reference are deliberately not part of this wire authority.

WorkspaceSigningIdentityState.description: Lifecycle state for a Workspace-scoped Ed25519 signing identity.

WorkspaceSummary.description: Public Workspace catalog item returned by `GET /api/workspaces`.

WorkspaceWorkerDiscoveryItem.description:
Bounded, model-safe projection used by privileged Workspace Worker discovery.
Runtime placement appears only in the typed subject required by Worker
control operations; provider and launch internals are intentionally omitted.
